mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follow_relations WHERE followed_id=#{userId}) AS follower_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follow_relations WHERE follower_id=#{userId}) AS following_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM videos WHERE author_id=#{userId} AND status='PUBLISHED') AS published_video_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_likes l JOIN videos v ON v.id=l.video_id WHERE v.author_id=#{userId} AND v.status='PUBLISHED') AS received_like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_favorites f JOIN videos v ON v.id=f.video_id WHERE v.author_id=#{userId} AND v.status='PUBLISHED') AS received_favorite_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_records p JOIN videos v ON v.id=p.video_id WHERE v.author_id=#{userId} AND v.status='PUBLISHED') AS received_play_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM share_records s JOIN videos v ON v.id=s.video_id WHERE v.author_id=#{userId} AND v.status='PUBLISHED') AS received_share_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c JOIN videos v ON v.id=c.video_id WHERE v.author_id=#{userId} AND v.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.is_deleted=FALSE) AS received_comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_records WHERE user_id=#{userId}) AS active_play_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_likes WHERE user_id=#{userId}) AS active_like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_favorites WHERE user_id=#{userId}) AS active_favorite_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM share_records WHERE user_id=#{userId}) AS active_share_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND is_deleted=FALSE) AS active_comment_count
